title: From Team Workflow to AI Capability
subtitle: Hands-on AI delivery, adoption, and product judgment across the full loop.

cv.note: Tailored for the Head of AI Enablement role

bio.short: I turn complex, domain-specific workflows into AI-enabled tools and repeatable product capabilities. At Bibel TV, I shipped a Microsoft Copilot support workflow and built Claude and n8n systems. I also helped nontechnical teams adopt new ways of working. I combine hands-on delivery with product judgment and change leadership.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV, I started with the work people already did and stayed with it through implementation and adoption. For viewer services, I designed and introduced a production Microsoft Copilot skill grounded in the team handbook and house voice. Complex multi-topic letters now take minutes rather than hours. Temporary staff can produce on-brand drafts from day one. Initially skeptical colleagues returned after trying it on difficult cases. The rollout was optional and supported with one-to-one coaching, so adoption had to be earned.

I also build the systems behind the workflow. For a donor-funded nonprofit I built an AI fundraising ecosystem solo, from performance analysis and prompt architecture through a working prototype and shipped Claude skill. I operated active n8n pipelines for content processing. I also helped establish Claude for the product team with MCPs and guidelines. I helped manage member access, token plans, and overages while contributing to prototyping setups. My role was hands-on and collaborative rather than company-wide governance ownership.

The pattern extends beyond AI. At ChurchDesk, I turned phone-based funeral coordination into a reusable capability inside the existing calendar and form builder. The result was 70% less coordination time and 90% acceptance, followed by rollout to the full customer base. At Hypoport, I helped move bespoke internal support toward standardized offerings through recurring workshops and reviews. Across these settings, I follow the same principle. Understand where the work happens, preserve the judgment that matters, and build a capability people can use and maintain.

context.company: Shine, part of Cegid, builds financial software for entrepreneurs and small businesses. The CEO Office role works company-wide across functions such as Finance, HR, Sales, and Customer Support.
context.role: Head of AI Enablement combines hands-on building with adoption. The role finds valuable workflows, builds and operates AI tools, coaches sustained use, and measures the resulting change.
context.emphasis: Lead with the Bibel TV support Copilot as the closest proof of workflow discovery, practical AI delivery, coaching, and earned adoption. Then show hands-on AI systems and the longer pattern of turning specific workflows into reusable capabilities. Use American English.
